cases.customer_question: Does a gateway product require Bluetooth qualification if Bluetooth capability is provided only by connecting a commercially available qualified USB Bluetooth dongle?
question_variants: Must a gateway be Bluetooth qualified when using an external dongle?
Does a non-Bluetooth device become a Bluetooth product by attaching a certified dongle?
Is qualification required for a USB-dongle-based Bluetooth option?
Should the gateway and dongle be qualified as a combined product?
Does attaching a qualified Bluetooth dongle create a new qualification obligation?
cases.actual_issue: Determining Bluetooth qualification scope when Bluetooth functionality is supplied entirely by an externally attached, already-qualified Bluetooth USB dongle.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The gateway itself did not contain an implemented Bluetooth function. Bluetooth capability was added only when a separately qualified USB Bluetooth dongle was connected. The question was whether the gateway and dongle must be re-qualified together as a combined Bluetooth product.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant stated that a device does not require Bluetooth logo qualification solely because a qualified Bluetooth dongle can be attached through a USB hub. As long as Bluetooth functionality is not implemented in the gateway itself, qualification is generally not required for the gateway. The consultant compared this to a non-Bluetooth PC that becomes Bluetooth-capable through a commercial USB dongle without requiring separate qualification of the PC-and-dongle combination.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth qualification responsibility follows the implementation of Bluetooth functionality. If the Bluetooth technology resides in a separately qualified external dongle and is not implemented within the host product itself, the host product is not treated as requiring its own Bluetooth qualification on that basis alone.
cases.final_recommendation: Verify that Bluetooth functionality is entirely provided by the qualified external dongle and not implemented in the gateway itself. If that condition is satisfied, treat the gateway as outside the Bluetooth qualification scope described in this thread.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: A company could perform unnecessary qualification work for products that do not actually implement Bluetooth functionality. Conversely, incorrectly claiming exemption when Bluetooth functionality is implemented in the host product could result in an invalid qualification position.
